natalie: Kicked off NovaThera perf bench. baseline vs q4/q8 matrix. quick notes.
quentin: target load?
natalie: customer wants sustained 600 qps, peaks 2.5k. ran 20m at 600 (seq 80).
sam: results?
natalie: median baseline 68ms, q4 56ms. p95 baseline 150ms, q4 170ms. p99 baseline 310ms, q4 had 6 spikes between 700-1,100ms correlated with prefix churn.
quentin: spikes during prefix churn suggests cold KV misses + prefetch not keeping up.
mike: did you capture kernel metrics and nvlink counters?
natalie: yes. nvlink bandwidth saturated briefly during spikes. run cmd: ```./bench --model redwood-large-v1 --variant q4_0 --seq 80 --qps 600 --concurrency 12 --prefetch async --ramp 420```
infer-bot: ded pool "ded-aws-16g" reservation available 2026-06-18 01:00-04:00 UTC.
sam: plan: run 3x 45m with synthetic prefix skew (60% hot, 40% unique) and run an AZ failover mid-run to stress routing. collect kernel eviction, nvlink, and memcpy stalls.
quentin: security ask: NovaThera needs KMS-in-customer-account + SOC2. possible?
mike: yes for Dedicated/Private. support CloudHSM + customer KMS for keys. legal to handle BAA.
natalie: pricing question: procurement wants uplift for reserved 2.5k peak with 10% headroom vs PAYG. need ballpark by EOD.
quentin: rough: reserved + SLA ~ $24k/mo, PAYG ~ $44k/mo. if q4 stabilizes we can concede ~15% token cost saving.
sam: next actions: run the 3x45m soak with AZ cutover in ded-aws-16g window, include canary fallback route to baseline for 10% tail traffic, upload perf counters and traces.
infer-bot: Slot earmarked: ded-aws-16g, 2026-06-18 01:00-04:00 UTC.
natalie: will post csv/trace links after run and draft pricing note for NovaThera procurement.
quentin: thanks team. if we hit 99p <350ms at 600 qps in Dedicated, sales will progress to contract talks."
